scope: Backend discovery projection of service-authored NIP-51 kind 30002 relay sets for browser bootstrap, ContextVM request/reply, and service publish/backfill policy.
intended_behavior: The backend projector publishes service-key-signed NIP-51 relay sets for bahia-browser-v1, bahia-contextvm-v1, and bahia-service-v1 during system discovery projection.

bahia-browser-v1 is sourced from the public browser relay policy source, bahia-contextvm-v1 is sourced from the ContextVM relay policy source with the approved browser fallback, and bahia-service-v1 is sourced from the service publish/backfill relay policy source.
Sidecar-enabled discovery fails deterministically when public browser relay policy is absent instead of publishing incomplete discovery or silently falling back to raw service relays.

Relay-set publication uses the existing signed publish path so relay OK rejection and aggregate publish errors are surfaced to the snapshot caller; partial relay failure behavior remains owned by the RelayPool health/result path.
out_of_scope: Advisory service NIP-65 publication for bahia-8epx.5
AUTH epic behavior changes for bahia-8epx.7
